leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a custom hook function with TypeScript generics to encapsulate WebSocket logic
Implement useState hooks to manage WebSocket connection status and message data
Apply useEffect hooks to establish and clean up WebSocket connections
Construct event handler functions to process incoming WebSocket messages
Utilize useCallback to memoize WebSocket message sending functions
Execute conditional logic to handle different WebSocket ready states
Control WebSocket lifecycle by implementing connection opening and closing functions
Return an object from the custom hook containing connection state and control methods
Invoke the custom WebSocket hook within a React component to access real-time data
Assign TypeScript interfaces to define the shape of WebSocket messages and hook return values
Modify component state in response to WebSocket connection status changes
Access WebSocket instance methods to send data through the established connection
